<!-- ZE-AUTH-014 / ONB-010: real-time subdomain availability (mirrors /get-started). Debounced GET to the
     checkSubdomain transition (validate#Subdomain) shows Available / taken / invalid under the field.
     Advisory only — provision#Tenant re-validates on submit. -->
<script>(function(){
  function init(){
    var inp=document.querySelector('input[name=subdomain]'); if(!inp) return;
    var msg=document.createElement('div'); msg.id='subdomain-availability'; msg.setAttribute('aria-live','polite');
    msg.style.cssText='font-size:12.5px;margin:6px 0 0;line-height:1.45;min-height:16px;font-weight:600';
    (inp.closest('.form-group')||inp.parentNode).appendChild(msg);
    var t, lastQ='';
    function show(txt,color){ msg.textContent=txt; msg.style.color=color; }
    function check(){
      var v=(inp.value||'').trim().toLowerCase();
      if(!v){ show('',''); lastQ=''; return; }
      if(v===lastQ) return; lastQ=v;
      show('Checking availability…','#7a828f');
      var url=location.pathname.replace(/\/$/,'')+'/checkSubdomain?sub='+encodeURIComponent(v);
      fetch(url,{credentials:'same-origin',headers:{'Accept':'application/json'}})
        .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
        .then(function(d){
          if((inp.value||'').trim().toLowerCase()!==v) return;
          if(d&&d.available){ show('✓ '+(d.canonical||v)+'.zetaclantech.com is available','#1c8a4a'); }
          else{ show('✗ '+((d&&d.reason)?d.reason:'Not available'),'#c62828'); }
        })
        .catch(function(){ if((inp.value||'').trim().toLowerCase()===v) show('Could not check availability right now.','#7a828f'); });
    }
    inp.addEventListener('input',function(){ clearTimeout(t); t=setTimeout(check,450); });
    inp.addEventListener('blur',function(){ clearTimeout(t); check(); });
  }
  if(document.readyState!=='loading') init(); else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init);
})();</script>
